name: Super Real Mahjong P7
original_name: スーパーリアル麻雀 P7
source:
In hot summer, the protagonist comes to Izu for vacation, where he meets two Asahina sisters accompanied by their private tutor Serika and a part-time housekeeper Etsuko at the villa.

The girls challenge the protagonist in mahjong games for various reasons and a story of hot summer begins at the villa.
